Que vous recherchiez un CDI, un CDD, une alternance, un stage ou une mission d’intérim, Hellowork vous accompagne à chaque étape pour trouver un job adapté à votre profil.

Avec l'application Hellowork pour ChatGPT, vous pouvez :

It helps users create proposals, manage policy information, handle claims, and process risk and coverage data efficiently. payload.name: Juicebox

payload.name: Pet Project Co-Founder AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
"Pet Project Co-Founder AI" is your market research assistant.

It will help you validate product ideas using real data from trusted market research services. No more guesses or hallucinations. Instead of relying on plain LLM-only answers, you will use raw market data interpreted by ChatGPT as clear insights.

You do not need prior marketing experience. You just ask a question and the app builds a market research plan for you. The plan will include gathering data from third-party services. You are guided through what services to use and what queries to run there. After you use the recommended service, you copy-paste their data back to the app and get a clear interpretation from ChatGPT.

Examples of questions you can get answers to:
- "I have an idea for the app X. Is there enough demand to justify building it?"
- "What are people searching for when they want Y?"
- "Who exactly is my target user for the app Z? What platforms do they use?"
- "I built an app W. Where do I find users for it?"

For now, the following services are supported:
- SparkToro — audience intelligence (who your users are, what they read, who they follow)
- Ubersuggest — keyword demand and SEO metrics
- AnswerThePublic — real search questions and phrasing

Disclaimers:
- This app does not automatically gather data from the recommended market research services. The app helps with building search queries for these services and reporting the resulting data back. But you will need to visit and use these services yourself. We do not automatically scrape data from these services.
- This app does not provide paid subscriptions to the recommended market research services. You use these services according to their terms of use.
- This app currently supports a limited set of services: SparkToro, Ubersuggest, and AnswerThePublic. Only these services may be recommended during marketing research. Keep in mind that there are other good services for market research on the internet, we just do not support them yet. You can request adding new services by emailing the [developer@petprojectcofounder.ai](mailto:developer@petprojectcofounder.ai)
- For the best experience, it is recommended to use this app on desktop

payload.name: Heepsy Influencer Search

payload.name: Needle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Needle is a customer discovery platform for founders and go-to-market (GTM) teams. Search public conversations across  Reddit, Hacker News, GitHub, Stack Overflow, X, and more - and see threads ranked by buying intent and sentiment. Find people already talking about your product, comparing alternatives, or looking for solutions like yours - with digest alerts when new matches appear.

The Needle ChatGPT App gives users access to their general business information such as website and contact email address. The app also allows users to contact the Needle team.

payload.name: Postbeam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Postbeam connects ChatGPT to your LinkedIn content workflow so you can draft, review, schedule, and analyze posts without leaving the chat. 

Once connected with your Postbeam account, ChatGPT works directly with your real posts, your writing guidance, and your performance data. Turning a chat box into the place you actually run your LinkedIn presence & strategy.

Draft in your voice, from your real work:
Ask ChatGPT to write a post and it pulls in your Postbeam content training, your mission, audience, format rules, and content sources so every draft sounds like you, not generic. Because it's working inside ChatGPT, it can also draw raw material from the other tools you've connected (Slack threads, Gmail, meeting recorders like Fellow or Granola) and turn a real customer calls, shipped features, or team wins into finished posts. Drafts are saved straight into Postbeam for review.

Edit, organize, and manage your queue:
Review your most recent drafts, pull up any single post, and edit its copy or title — all by chatting. You can attach media: images, video, or carousel posts. List posts by status (draft, approved, scheduled) to see exactly where everything stands.

Approve and schedule when you're ready:
When a draft is ready, ChatGPT can approve it and schedule it to publish to your connected LinkedIn at a specific time. Nothing publishes automatically drafts stay drafts until a person decides otherwise, and approving or scheduling respects the permissions on your account.

Understand what's working:
Ask what's performing and get answers from your cached analytics: account-level totals (impressions, reactions, comments, reshares, followers gained, members reached) with a daily trend, plus per-post breakdowns over 30-, 90-, or 365-day windows. Use it to spot your best formats and hooks, then immediately draft your next post in that proven style.

Built for teams and agencies:
Postbeam supports multiple accounts in one place. ChatGPT can list every account you can access, so agencies and teams can switch between clients or teammates and keep each person's drafts, approvals, and analytics cleanly separated.

payload.name: ZeroBounce
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Validate your emails instantly with ZeroBounce’s ChatGPT-powered assistant. This app lets you quickly test and verify email addresses before sending campaigns, helping you reduce bounce rates, protect your sender reputation, and improve deliverability.

payload.name: Ignition
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ignition helps users find and manage practice clients, proposals, forms, invoices, payments, services, templates, and related workflow records through ChatGPT. The app supports read workflows, draft creation, private workspace updates, and explicit client-send actions for proposals, forms, and invoices.

payload.name: OriginalVoices
payload.description: Get human insight on any topic
payload.summaryOriginal: Get human insight on any topic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The human intelligence layer for AI.

OriginalVoices gives ChatGPT instant access to real human perspectives - so you can ground decisions and AI outputs in what your target audience actually thinks, feels, and values.

Instead of guessing or relying on assumptions, get authentic feedback from real people directly inside ChatGPT. Share ideas, test messaging, validate concepts, or explore what matters to any audience - and use those insights to understand your audience, inform better decisions and create more targeted AI outputs.

With OriginalVoices, you can:
- Define any target audience
- Share anything - questions, links, copy, product concepts, campaign ideas
- Get instant responses from our network of tens of thousands of Digital Twins - AI representations of real people, each owned, trained, and validated by the person they represent

What you can use OriginalVoices for
- OriginalVoices brings real human intelligence into ChatGPT - turning every conversation into an opportunity to understand and act on authentic audience perspectives.
- Test messaging, copy, or creative concepts with your target audience
- Understand what people care about and why it matters to them
- Get feedback on landing pages, product ideas, or campaign strategies
- Create content and ads that resonates with specific audiences
- Compare perspectives across different demographics or segments
- Conduct qualitative research without the wait

How it works
- Tag OriginalVoices in ChatGPT
- Describe your target audience (e.g., "parents of toddlers in the UK," "Gen Z interested in sustainability," "small business owners")
- Share what you want feedback on - a question, a URL, an idea, copy you've written - anything
- OriginalVoices identifies relevant Digital Twins and gathers their responses. Individual perspectives are returned directly in ChatGPT, giving you real human context to inform decisions and shape outputs.
- Get started with the OriginalVoices ChatGPT App today - and bring real human insight into your AI workflows.

payload.name: LegalZoom
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LegalZoom provides reliable legal information to help you start and run your business. Use the app to ask questions, discover relevant LegalZoom resources, and receive guided next steps for common legal tasks.

What you can do:
1. Understand business formation basics (LLC vs. corporation, common filing steps)
2. Get help navigating contracts (what to include, when to use which agreement)
3. Learn about compliance and updates (registered agent, annual/biennial requirements, amendments)

Important: This app provides legal information and educational content—it does not provide legal advice and is not a substitute for a lawyer. If you need advice for your specific situation, consider speaking with an attorney.

payload.name: Linktree
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: With Linktree’s ChatGPT app, you can find the perfect creator match for your campaign requirements - search for creators based on location, content categories, follower count, or a combination of all three.

payload.name: Triple Whale

payload.name: Brand24
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring your Brand24 insights directly into ChatGPT.

The Brand24 app in ChatGPT gives you instant access to social listening insights through simple conversations. Instead of digging through dashboards, exporting reports, or manually analyzing mentions, you can ask ChatGPT questions about your brand, competitors or campaigns and get answers based on your Brand24 data.

Whether you're a marketer, PR specialist, agency, or analyst, Brand24 app helps you turn online conversations into actionable insights in seconds.

What can you ask ChatGPT?
"What's the current sentiment around my brand?" - Instantly understand how people feel about your brand and identify the topics driving positive or negative conversations.
"Summarize my project from the last 30 days." - Get a concise overview of key trends, spikes in mentions, sentiment changes, and the most important discussions.
"Compare my brand with competitors." - Analyze share of voice, sentiment, reach, and discussion volume across multiple brands without building reports manually.
"What caused this spike in mentions?" - Quickly identify the events behind sudden increases in visibility.

Brand24 app makes ChatGPT more than just an AI assistant - it becomes a powerful source of real-time brand, market, and competitor intelligence powered by your Brand24 projects.

payload.name: Strety
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Strety helps leadership teams review company context, find and manage priorities, update scorecards, work through issues, coordinate to-dos, and maintain shared operating documents through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Stratws

payload.name: Lattice
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Performance management doesn't happen just in performance management software. It happens every day in 1:1s, in Slack, in the doc you're drafting at 9pm, and increasingly in the AI assistant you open before your email. Lattice MCP connects every signal you've already collected (reviews, 1:1s, feedback, goals, and weekly updates) into ChatGPT, so the agent you already use can finally see your team the way you do.

Ask a question, get an answer grounded in your actual people data. Draft an accurate review in 90 seconds. Submit it without leaving the conversation. Outline the calibration story before justifying it in the meeting. Because Lattice MCP respects your existing Lattice permissions, every answer is scoped to exactly what you'd see in-product.

For AI-native organizations with adoption initiatives already in motion and other MCP connectors running in their stack, Lattice MCP is the missing piece. Bring your reviews, 1:1s, feedback, goals, and updates into the same chat your managers are already prompting in. Draft from the full picture. Submit the result back to Lattice without ever leaving the conversation. That's the round-trip no other best-in-class Performance Management tool completes today.

payload.name: Zoom Revenue Accelerator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to Zoom Revenue Accelerator to look up sales conversations, transcripts, AI summaries, deals, teams, and coaching scorecards. Ask natural-language questions about customer meetings and pipeline activity, then get grounded answers from the records you already have access to.

payload.name: Meltwater
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Meltwater MCP server connects AI tools and workflows to Meltwater’s media and social intelligence. Search billions of news articles and social posts, retrieve live metrics, trends, and sentiment, generate Boolean queries, and manage saved searches — all through natural language. Requires an active Meltwater subscription.

payload.name: Enginy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Enginy helps B2B sales and prospecting teams build lead lists, enrich contacts, and run outreach campaigns from ChatGPT.

Search for companies and people that match your ideal customer profile, then verify emails and phone numbers, find LinkedIn profiles, and organize the results into lists. Draft and launch multi-step email and LinkedIn sequences, review replies from your inbox, and check campaign and conversation analytics.

Enginy connects to your existing workspace, so you can work with the contacts, companies, lists, and campaigns your team already has, and keep everything in sync with your CRM. An Enginy account is required.

payload.name: SurveySparrow: Forms & Surveys
payload.description: Build and run forms or surveys
payload.summaryOriginal: Build and run forms or surveys
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create surveys and forms, distribute them to respondents, and analyze the results — all within a single ChatGPT conversation using the SurveySparrow app.

What you can do:
- Design surveys and forms for any use-case (NPS, feedback, employee engagement, and more)
- Publish surveys to your SurveySparrow account and distribute them via email, SMS, or WhatsApp
- Review live response counts and track survey activity across your account
- Analyze responses and surface patterns or key themes from collected data

Example prompts:

1. Build a survey
"Create an NPS survey for customers who purchased in the last 30 days with a rating scale and an open-ended follow-up question"

2. Edit a survey
"Add a required email field and make question 5 more concise"

3. Publish a survey
"Publish this survey to my SurveySparrow account so it's ready to collect responses"

4. Share a survey
"Send this NPS survey to my customer list via email"

5. Check response activity
"How many people have completed the customer feedback form?"

6. Track your survey library
"How many NPS surveys are active right now?"

7. Analyze responses
"Group the responses by common themes and show me the top 3 insights"

Requirements: An active SurveySparrow account is required to use this app.

payload.name: LicitaLAB
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LicitaLAB permite encontrar, analizar y entender compras públicas de forma rápida y estructurada.
La plataforma extrae información clave desde documentos de licitación, incluyendo requisitos técnicos, plazos, montos y criterios de evaluación, facilitando la comprensión de cada oportunidad sin necesidad de revisar archivos extensos.
Los usuarios pueden explorar oportunidades, revisar documentos asociados y tomar decisiones informadas en menos tiempo. Además, pueden hacer preguntas en lenguaje natural sobre oportunidades específicas, proveedores, compradores y sobre el uso de la plataforma.
LicitaLAB está diseñada para profesionales y organizaciones que participan en compras públicas y necesitan evaluar múltiples procesos de manera eficiente, reduciendo el tiempo de análisis y mejorando la calidad de sus ofertas.

payload.name: Arcade

Give ChatGPT a prompt, screenshots, or notes from a call, and it generates an on-brand video with visuals, animations, and narration. You can also query performance data from your existing Arcades to see which demos are driving engagement. Useful for product marketing, sales follow-ups, product releases, and paid ads. Use together with other Apps such as Figma, Granola, Notion, Slack, and Apollo to automate workflows end to end.

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The BrightEdge app retrieves metrics from a user's connected BrightEdge account, covering both AEO, GEO, and traditional SEO performance across LLMs. It returns AEO citations and mentions, AEO and SEO competitor benchmarking, keyword rank data, page-level performance, Share of Voice competitive scores, Google Search Console and web analytics metrics, AI Overview citation gap analysis, and recommendations. ChatGPT helps users work with BrightEdge data more effectively by combining analyses across different datasets, asking follow-up questions, and turning SEO and AEO metrics into clear insights within a single conversation.

payload.name: ABRAMS Trade Intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ABRAMS Trade Intelligence is a read-only research app for customs, sourcing, sales, and market-analysis teams. It focuses on three workflows: finding the most likely catalog-verified HS code and related trade context, researching international suppliers for a product, and researching buyers or potential customers. Product classification may ask one grouped clarification round and then returns the best available official HS-6 result, with CN-8 or TARIC-10 context when verified. Results can include assumptions, confidence, import and export signals, markets, company names, countries, shipment scope, and verified ABRAMS World Trade Wiki links. The supporting company-profile tool is limited to companies represented in ABRAMS trade results and is not promoted as a standalone directory. The app does not contact companies, create leads, change records, create accounts, process payments, or complete transactions. Classifications and trade signals are informational research aids, not binding tariff rulings, legal advice, or compliance guarantees.

payload.name: Company Dossier
payload.description: 附有来源的公司情报档案
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Company Dossier compiles a complete, source-attributed intelligence file on any company or domain — entirely from public data. One request returns nine sections: overview & identity, people & org chart, hiring radar, money trail, locations, tech fingerprint, news & timeline, relationship web, and risk flags. Every claim is tied to a public source and tagged High/Medium/Low confidence. Built for due diligence, vendor vetting, sales prep, and competitive research. No accounts, no private data — public sources only.
payload.longDescription: Company Dossier 完全利用公开数据，为任意公司或域名编制完整且注明来源的情报档案。一次请求返回九个部分：概况与身份、人员与组织架构、招聘动态、资金动向、地点、技术特征、新闻与时间线、关系网络，以及风险提示。每条陈述都关联公开来源，并标注高、中或低置信度。适用于尽职调查、供应商审查、销售准备和竞争研究。无需账户，不涉及私有数据，仅使用公开来源。

payload.name: VectorGov
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VectorGov helps users research Brazilian federal public procurement legislation, official federal purchasing catalog items, and TCU procurement decisions from ChatGPT. Users can search curated legal sources, consult exact texts, browse catalog classifications, and verify answers with evidence links.

payload.name: SonicJobs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SonicJobs helps you discover job opportunities by searching across 3+ million job listings in one place.

Instead of visiting multiple career pages individually, SonicJobs lets you run a single search to explore roles by job title, company, or location. It brings together opportunities from many employers so you can quickly see what’s available and identify positions that match what you’re looking for.

The app is designed to simplify job discovery. Whether you’re actively searching or just exploring the market, SonicJobs helps you browse opportunities without having to manually check dozens of company websites.

When you find a role that interests you, SonicJobs takes you to the original listing where you can review the full details and apply.

Key features
	•	Search across 3+ million job listings
	•	Find roles by title, company, or location
	•	Explore opportunities from many companies in a single search

payload.name: Cookiedeal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find Korean companies using industry, location, funding, and IT solution filters, and organize results in private company lists. Review company financials, ownership, public disclosures, DART reports, and view-only registry PDFs. Enrich spreadsheets with company data. A connected Cookiedeal account with an eligible active subscription is required. Priced data and registry requests use the organization's existing usage credits after a quote and cost approval.

payload.name: Firmable
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Firmable, your AI-native B2B sales intelligence platform – is now in your pocket. With 15 million+ verified company profiles and 135 million+ decision-maker contacts, Firmable gives your sales team the edge to reach the right buyer at exactly the right moment. 

Know who’s ready to buy 

Buying signals surface the accounts most likely to convert right now. Firmable monitors for role and leadership changes, funding rounds, hiring surges, and technology shifts - alerting you the moment a target account is ready to buy. No more guessing. No more chasing lukewarm leads 

Find the right contacts, fast 

Define your ICP (ideal customer profile) in plain English and build ICP-matched prospect lists in seconds. Filter by industry, company size, country, state, tech stack, and hiring activity. Then, access verified mobile numbers and email addresses for decision-makers. 

Trust the data you act on 

Firmable AI delivers accurate, continuously refreshed company and contact data, enriched with vital context that makes outreach smarter and more relevant. Firmable is ISO 27001 certified and built around secure, compliant data practices, giving teams confidence in every move they make.  

Keep your CRM fresh 

Agentic two-way CRM sync and enrichment update your records as accounts change. Firmable provides native integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, and Microsoft Dynamics 365. 

Trusted by 1,300+ businesses 

Rated 4.7/5 on G2. Privacy-compliant data you can prospect with confidently.

payload.name: STACK
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
STACK is a construction takeoff and estimating platform used by estimators and preconstruction teams. This connector links your AI assistant to your STACK account so you can work with your projects, takeoffs, and estimates just by describing what you want — no code, and nothing to install.

Once connected, your assistant can:
• Find and review existing work — search projects and takeoffs, open and review estimates, and look things up in your takeoff libraries.
• Create, update, and import — start new projects (including straight from an invitation-to-bid email), update project details, make bulk edits to takeoffs, and import from your libraries and company lists.

You stay in control. You sign in on STACK's own secure page using standard OAuth 2.0 — your assistant never sees your password. A STACK-branded approval screen lets you choose exactly which capabilities to grant, and you can allow read-only work (finding and reviewing) without allowing changes. Before it creates, updates, or imports anything, your assistant shows you what it's about to do and waits for your approval.

Your existing STACK permissions always apply: the connector can only see and change what you already could, and STACK enforces the same company ownership and user permissions it always has.

payload.name: Canonical Company Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Canonical is verified company search for research and prospecting.

  - Describe companies in plain language, or use structured filters like location, headcount, funding stage, investor, and founder background.
  - Get a precise, LLM-verified, domain-keyed shortlist of real companies instead of a page of links.
  - Search for companies that match specific criteria.
  - Find look-alike companies based on a company you already know.
  - Pull full company profiles, including founders and where they worked before.
  - Resolve a company name to its correct domain.
  - Check your Canonical credit balance.
  - Useful for sales prospecting, market research, competitor research, investor mapping, and sourcing.
  - Free to start, no credit card required.

payload.name: Pendo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pendo helps users inspect product usage, customer feedback, guides, surveys, session replay, AI agent analytics, segments, and Orchestrate journeys from ChatGPT. The app supports read workflows for analytics and discovery, plus gated write workflows for creating or updating Pendo records when the user explicitly asks.

payload.name: Youtrust
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Manage your Youtrust signature requests directly from ChatGPT, without opening a new tab. Check whether someone has signed, get a full overview of everything still pending, and send documents from your templates, all in plain language. Ask questions, confirm statuses, and handle e-signatures while staying in the flow of what you were already doing.

Youtrust enables businesses to easily and securely manage legally-binding electronic signatures, identity verification, and electronic seals, in full compliance with European standards such as eIDAS.

payload.name: G2 MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use G2 data in ChatGPT to research and compare software using verified reviews and product information. Explore Research Boards to evaluate and compare solutions, and access Buyer Intent data to understand how companies are researching and engaging with products and competitors.

payload.name: inblog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: inblog connects your company blog to ChatGPT. Draft a post and get a private preview link before anything goes live, publish or schedule it, review traffic and Google Search Console keywords to decide what to write next, manage tags, authors and redirects, and update the blog's banner and custom design code. Requires an inblog account on the Team plan or higher; every action follows the permissions the signed-in user already has on that blog.

payload.name: Success.co
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Success.co MCP Server lets you control your entire Success.co workspace directly from ChatGPT.

Instead of clicking around inside the app, you can simply talk to ChatGPT and ask it to do things for you. You can draft a new process document, complete a to do, create or update an Issue, review your Rocks, check on scorecard numbers, or prepare for an upcoming session. It works like a natural conversation, but it is connected to your real data.

Because Success.co already holds a clear, structured picture of how your company runs EOS, ChatGPT can use that data to generate powerful insights and reports. You can ask it to summarize execution across teams, highlight risks, spot patterns in Issues, or generate a planning brief. The only limit is what you choose to ask. It is your data, your operating system, simply made available to ChatGPT so you can leverage it more fully.

It is also especially useful when you are on the move. Using the ChatGPT app, you can add to dos or Issues with your voice, capture ideas as they happen, and keep execution moving without waiting to get back to your desk.

The Success.co MCP Server makes ChatGPT a practical control layer for your company’s EOS data, helping you move faster, think more clearly, and stay aligned.

payload.name: eSignatures.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create, send, and manage legally binding contracts without ever leaving ChatGPT.

Build from scratch or from reusable templates, generate a draft to review before it goes out, then add signers and track everything from draft to signed, all through plain conversation.

Need to fix a typo or adjust a clause after a contract's already been sent for signature? There's no need to void it and start over. Edit the content directly, mid-process, and keep things moving.

Perfect for NDAs, service agreements, and any contract you need to get out the door fast, with full visibility into where every signature stands.

payload.name: Runrun.it
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT to your Runrun.it workspace to manage work without leaving the conversation. This app lets you quickly create one or multiple tasks and search existing tasks, using your actual Runrun.it data and permissions.

It also helps you add the right context by letting you browse boards, stages, task types, projects, and tags before creating tasks—so what you create is already organized the way your team works. Great for turning ideas into tasks, and finding the status of work fast.

payload.name: Mergado
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Mergado is a product feed management platform for e-commerce. Connect your Mergado account to audit product feeds, manage rules, and optimize your product data for marketplaces like Google Shopping, Facebook, and Heureka — all from ChatGPT.

payload.name: Adobe Workfront
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search, summarize, create, and update projects, tasks, workspaces, planning records  and approvals. Make Adobe Workfront a native part of your AI workflow — an AI-powered work management agent that helps you stay on top of deadlines, surface risks, and move work forward faster.

payload.name: Data Bloo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Data Bloo helps you ask questions about your performance and get clear answers from your connected data sources. No exports, no spreadsheets, no manual reporting.

Use it to check campaign performance, compare channels, spot trends, and summarize key takeaways for your team or clients.

Data Bloo works with sources including Facebook Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Bing Ads, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, Instagram Insights, Facebook Insights, WooCommerce, and more.

payload.name: Socialstats
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Socialstats helps authorized creators, brands, and teams inspect current and historical social performance, audience geography, public content, top posts, and source-level trends in ChatGPT. Enterprise-backed lookups preserve Socialstats access controls and update the member's normal request or search accounting.

payload.name: Ironclad Contracts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ironclad's MCP server lets ChatGPT search your contract repository and workflows using plain language. Ask things like "which MSAs are expiring in the next 90 days" or "show me vendor agreements with termination for convenience clauses" - and get back the right contracts and answers instantly. An extension of Ironclad's contract search results are automatically scoped to each user's permissions, so your team spends less time searching and more time acting on what they find.

payload.name: Hebbia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring Hebbia's institutional intelligence into ChatGPT and Codex. The Hebbia MCP server lets you tap into your firm's knowledge and premium public to make better decisions on deals and investments and run financial workflows from research to reports, slides, and financial models.

payload.name: Demandbase
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Demandbase integration with ChatGPT and Codex gives sales, marketing, and GTM teams seamless access to rich B2B data directly within ChatGPT and Codex for faster account research, prospecting, and engagement.

This app connects ChatGPT and Codex to Demandbase via a secure MCP connection, giving you access to both first-party and third-party data.

Third-Party Data (3P): Search and retrieve industry-leading company and contact data from Demandbase, including firmographics, technographics, family trees, company news, and leadership profiles.

First-Party Data (1P): Securely access your organization's Demandbase data, including known accounts, contacts, CRM entities, engagement, in-flight opportunities, intent signals, and buying-group data.

Account Brief: Generate a single, consolidated account overview combining engagement state, opportunities, buying-group coverage, intent signals, company profile, and recent news in a single request.

What you can do
Search companies by name, location, size, revenue, or industry
Discover decision-makers and influencers by role or job level
Fetch full company profiles, including recent news and competitors
Tap into 1P signals such as engagement, MQA status, and account activity
Identify buying intent on specific topics or keyword sets over time
Find net-new buying-group contacts that aren't already in your CRM
Pull a complete account brief in a single request for fast meeting preparation

Who it's for
Sales reps looking for fast answers about target accounts in real time
Marketing teams enriching leads and refining personas
RevOps and Enablement teams embedding GTM intelligence into workflows
AI product teams building agent-powered workflows

Availability

This integration is available to Demandbase customers with the appropriate Demandbase licenses and entitlements.

To request access, please contact your Demandbase Customer Success Manager (CSM).

For technical support, contact support@demandbase.com.

payload.name: AmbitionBox
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AmbitionBox is a career-focused platform that helps professionals make informed decisions using anonymous, verified workplace insights from real employees. Users can explore company reviews, salary benchmarks, compensation trends, work culture feedback, benefits, and career growth insights to evaluate companies and understand their market value before making career decisions.

Key Features and Offerings

Company Reviews & Insights

Access verified reviews from current and former employees across companies and industries. Users can understand workplace culture, management quality, work-life balance, benefits, career progression, compensation sentiment, and overall employee experience.

Salary Insights

Explore company-specific salary insights. Users can compare compensation across companies, understand typical salary ranges, view salary buckets by years of experience.

Dream Company Explorer

Explore dream companies & right companies for your designation

payload.name: Crossbeam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your ChatGPT workspace to Crossbeam and bring Ecosystem Intelligence into every AI workflow. The Crossbeam MCP Server lets ChatGPT securely access your partner and account data — surfacing overlaps, partner activity, and warm paths directly in chat. Use it to enrich AI responses with real-time ecosystem context, power smarter prioritization, and uncover co-sell opportunities without leaving your conversation.

payload.name: Actively
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Win more deals with Actively by directly accessing your always-on per account agents that help you drive the next best action. Actively’s per-account agents are synthesizing across all of your internal context (ex. CRM data, call transcripts, emails) and external signals to drive actionable intelligence. Designed for SDRs, AEs, AMs, and revenue leaders who need deep, contextual account knowledge, from meeting prep and deal strategy to territory prioritization.

payload.name: Jiminny
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring Jiminny context into ChatGPT. Search calls, understand deals, generate follow-ups, and get answers grounded in real customer conversations — including transcripts, insights, snippets, and deal data.

payload.name: StoreInspect
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: StoreInspect helps users research Shopify stores from ChatGPT. Users can check plan and usage limits, browse StoreInspect taxonomy values, look up individual Shopify stores, search filtered store lists, enrich domains with detected technologies and contact previews, search contact previews, and reveal approved contact channels when they explicitly confirm spending StoreInspect contact credits.

payload.name: GetMeDesign
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The App helps users discover and connect with freelancers and full-time professionals across a variety of skills and industries.

Users can browse profiles, explore experience and portfolios, and find the right talent for their needs. The app also allows professionals to showcase their work and make themselves discoverable to potential clients and employers.

By bringing talent and opportunities together in one place, the app makes it easier to find, evaluate, and connect with the right people.

payload.name: AdAnalyze
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AdAnalyze is a diagnostic tool for reviewing marketing and advertising content. It analyzes ads, landing pages, and marketing copy using predefined evaluation frameworks and highlights clarity issues, missing elements, and potential risks.

payload.name: Nas.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nas.com is an AI-powered business platform designed for solo sellers, creators, educators, coaches, and entrepreneurs who want to start and grow an online business quickly. It helps users build an online storefront, create product listings, generate marketing content, run ad campaigns, find customers, and accept payments from one place.
Instead of only hosting a store, Nas.com focuses on helping sellers market and sell their products using AI. Users can sell things like courses, templates, coaching sessions, digital products, handmade goods, apparel, jewelry, and other products or services. Its goal is to make it easier for people to work for themselves without needing coding skills, design experience, a large audience, or a full marketing team.

payload.name: Articulate EU
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connects ChatGPT to Articulate. Describe the training you're creating: topic, goals, who it's for, and how in-depth it should be. Then open and review the outline created for you in Articulate, and generate the full content for your interactive training. You can also search and browse your existing courses.

This version of the plugin is for European users with subscriptions hosted in Articulate’s EU data center.

Key use cases:

- Create a course outline
- Create a training package outline

payload.name: ClickFunnels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ClickFunnels helps users manage workspaces, contacts, funnels, sites, courses, email campaigns, communities, orders, forms, media, and webhooks through ChatGPT, with scoped read and write access selected during OAuth.

payload.name: Interview Feedback Extractor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Interview Feedback Extractor turns interview feedback into clean structured fields.

It extracts strengths, risks, and suggested next steps from recruiter or interviewer notes, helping recruiting workflows stay clear and consistent.

It only structures the feedback provided by the user. It does not make hiring decisions, contact candidates, schedule interviews, update ATS systems, or provide final recruiting judgments.

payload.name: Wednesday.app
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find Creators and Influencers with Wednesday.app inside ChatGPT

Discover the right creators without navigating multiple platforms. Simply describe what you’re looking for in plain language, and ChatGPT will return results powered by Wednesday.app’s search engine.

For example:
“Give me english-speaking TikTok creators interested in sustainable fashion with 50K–200K followers.”

Based on your request, you’ll receive a curated list of creator profiles that match your criteria. Review key details, explore their profiles, and check recent posts to evaluate whether they’re a strong fit for your next campaign.

Wednesday.app inside ChatGPT makes creator discovery faster, more intuitive, and easier to act on.

payload.name: AgentGrid.io - Shared Drive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Built for GPT, Codex, Claude, Grok Bot (GrokBot), Hermes, OpenClaw, Cursor: Humans and agents work on the same Brain, live Artifacts, Docs, Reports, Slides, Apps, Websites, Designs, with Shared Context such as Second Brain with full version history and access control.

payload.name: Catalog CLI Pro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Catalog CLI Pro helps users inspect uploaded Amazon Category Listing Reports from ChatGPT. Users can list available catalogs, run catalog quality audits, summarize priority issues, drill into specific checks such as missing attributes or intent-based bullet coverage, and understand duplicate-row filtering in scan results.

payload.name: CLEATUS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CLEATUS is the AI-native platform for government contractors. The CLEATUS app turns ChatGPT into a GovCon teammate with live access to your workspace: search federal, SLED, and Canadian opportunities plus pre-RFP forecasts across 40,000+ sources, manage your pipeline and pursuits, create and assign tasks, run saved searches, and draft and execute Workflows.

payload.name: SciLeads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your ideal biotech, pharma, and academic prospects - right in ChatGPT

Prospecting: find, prioritize, and message scientists. Use prompts to find scientists based on their papers, funding, conference activity, and clinical trials. Narrow down your list by geography, conference name, type or size of organization, recency, relevancy, and more. Get names, emails, and numbers straight away.

Outreach: draft a personalized message for each lead, which connects their work to your product - so you don't get left unread. Scale your lead gen without sacrificing quality and personalization.

payload.name: Sumsub
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your compliance operations into ChatGPT. Connect to your Sumsub account to onboard applicants, generate verification links, and pull live data on identities, businesses, transactions, AML screening cases, and fraud networks—all in plain language. Triage your review queue by risk, assemble due-diligence dossiers, investigate suspicious activity, and draft regulatory reports without clicking through the Dashboard. Turn full-cycle verification into an AI-powered workflow that moves at the speed of conversation.

payload.name: Just Domain
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
JustDomain is a domain name search you can run right in the chat. Name the domains you're considering - like acme.com, acme.io, or acme.ai - and instantly see which are available to register and exactly what each one costs. Every result lists both the first-year registration price and the annual renewal price in USD, so you understand the full long-term cost before you decide.

Search availability and pricing across hundreds of domain extensions (TLDs) -  from established options like .com, .net, and .io to newer ones like .ai, .dev, and .shop - checking a single name or many at once. When you're ready, open the domain in your browser to complete registration securely on justdomain.ai.

Ideal for founders, developers, and small businesses pricing out a new website, brand, app, or product.

payload.name: Reply.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Reply.io is a sales engagement platform. In ChatGPT it lets a user run their own Reply workspace in conversation: find sequences and check how they are performing, look up contacts and their activity history, review and answer replies in the shared inbox, work the AI SDR approval queue (see pending drafts, regenerate, approve, or reject them), manage mailboxes, sending schedules and safety limits, and diagnose why a sequence or mailbox is not sending. Every tool acts on the workspace the connected account already has access to, under that account's existing Reply permissions and API scopes.

payload.name: Givebutter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Givebutter is the fundraising and donor management platform trusted by tens of thousands of nonprofits. This app connects your Givebutter account to ChatGPT so your team can work with your fundraising data conversationally — no exports, no dashboards, no switching tabs.

Use it to:
- Look up donations, transactions, and payout activity across your campaigns
- Find and summarize donor and contact records, giving history, and engagement
- Check how a campaign, event, or fundraising page is performing
- Pull the numbers you need for board updates, grant reports, and end-of-month reconciliation

Ask things like:
- "How much did we raise in our spring appeal?"
- "Who are our top recurring donors this year?"
- "Summarize new donors from last week." 

ChatGPT retrieves the answer directly from your live Givebutter data and respects your existing account permissions — it can only access what your connected account can see.

Built and maintained by Givebutter. Authentication is handled securely through OAuth; you stay in control of access and can disconnect at any time.

payload.name: SeedLegals
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SeedLegals is the world’s most powerful legal and fundraising platform.

Connect ChatGPT to your SeedLegals account to work with your company's equity and legal documents. Ask about your cap table ownership, dilution, share classes, and SEIS/EIS scheme breakdowns, and see outstanding actions across your workflows. Find, read, and ask questions about your agreements, check who still needs to sign, send signature reminders, and share documents with your team. You can also create and update documents such as board minutes and employment agreements, directly from the conversation.

payload.name: QuoteCraft AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: QuoteCraft AI helps contractors and service businesses create first-pass estimates in ChatGPT for paver patios, lawn makeovers, and pressure washing. It collects project details, calculates low, working, and high estimates from deterministic pricing rules, and returns transparent assumptions, formula breakdowns, suggested upsells, and client-ready quote copy.
